children: Ferrellgas reported FY26 Adjusted EBITDA of $321.3M, down 3% YoY, and Q4 Adjusted EBITDA of $23.8M, up 3% YoY. FY26 net earnings were $71.7M versus a $15.6M loss in FY25.

AI Analyst View
FY26 Adj. EBITDA $321.3M, -3% YoY
Core profitability dipped, pressured by legacy liability settlements and softer demand.
Q4 Adj. EBITDA $23.8M, +3% YoY
Exit-quarter momentum suggests cost controls are helping despite warm weather.
FY26 net earnings $71.7M vs. $(15.6)M
Swing to profit driven by lapping prior year $125M legal settlement; one-time effect.
$650M 2026 notes redeemed; $650M 2031 issued
Refinancing extends maturities; interest expense rose $16.8M YoY.
Class B to Class A conversion completed
Simplifies equity, removes Class B payout, supporting future cash flow to debt/ops.
Liquidity $195.1M at 7/31/26
Adequate liquidity for seasonal needs and capex; reduces near-term risk.
Context by AI Analyst

This is a late confirmation of operational stabilization after prior restructuring and legal costs, with modest Q4 EBITDA growth. A colder season, sustained margin per gallon gains, and lower interest burden would be needed to turn this into a stronger, multi-quarter catalyst.
